description: Cockpit section and centre engine only. The aircraft flew KLM's first Amsterdam-Curaçao mail flight in December 1934 and was later converted to a wartime patrol bomber before being scrapped in 1946; the surviving parts stood for years in the museum garden; then were restored in the Netherlands and placed in a museum annex where they have been displayed since 1992.
